entities.name: Fernando de Andrade e Sotomayor
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fernando Andrade Sotomayor was a Roman Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Santiago de Compostela (1645–1655), Archbishop of Sigüenza (1640–1645), Archbishop of Burgos (1631–1640), and Bishop of Palencia (1628–1631).
